Subject: Cross-team Weekly: Outstanding Roadmap Points & Exec Inputs

Morning team — quick recap from today's cross-team sync and the follow-ups I promised to capture. This thread is to consolidate asks that need exec visibility for QBR prep and to surface exceptions that might change sprint scope. Please reply inline where you have updates.

Top items: 
- QBR executive inputs (see attached workbook) — we need final language for the two asks we plan to present to execs: (1) Dedicated capacity SKU for mid-market; (2) proposal for pilot pricing for Private deployments. Owner: Marissa — status?
- Roadmap exception: KV cache refactor slipped; proposed mitigation is a canary on dedicated with fallback to current runtime. Owner: Vivek — timing and risk table?
- Product ask from Oregon Analytics (Jordan) — they want a batch-embedding SLA and clarification on retention. Can we confirm expected latency and retention policy for Dedicated vs Hosted?

Action items (first pass):
1) Marissa — finalize exec slide text + attach commit ask (due 11/09 COB) — attachment: QBR_exec_inputs_v2.xlsx
2) Vivek — publish mitigation plan and risk matrix (due 11/08 EOD) — link: INF-2345
3) Lauren — consolidate procurement checklist for pilot pricing and procurement contacts at Aurora Health (due 11/09) — attach SOC2 requests to thread
4) Jonas — run a quick perf check on the canary plan (due 11/08 midday)

Please mark updates and if any item should be escalated to the exec thread directly.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

Open questions: where should we surface the estimated unit economics? I put a high-level cost breakdown in the workbook but would like finance review.

Attachment: QBR_exec_inputs_v2.xlsx

I'll take the owner for finalizing wording — will circulate by EOD 11/09.

-Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-07T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team Weekly: Outstanding Roadmap Points & Exec Inputs

Karthik — quick status on the KV cache refactor and mitigation plan. Summary below:
- Root cause: subtle regression in KV eviction under long sequences when running quantized model path.
- Impact: low frequency (~1.2% of latency-sensitive requests in our synthetic sample) but high P99 impact for sessions >3k tokens.
- Proposed mitigation: deploy refactor as a canary to Dedicated pool A (us-west) with auto-fallback to current runtime on error. Canary will run with 10% traffic and health checks for 48 hours.
- Risk: potential increased memory pressure during canary — I recommend a short maintenance window for the canary rollout.

I'll publish the mitigation plan and the risk table in INF-2345 by 11/08 12:00. Jonas, can you validate the perf test harness by 11/08 10:30?

-Vivek
VP Engineering, Serving Runtime
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team Weekly: Outstanding Roadmap Points & Exec Inputs

Vivek — validated the perf harness. Quick notes:
- Canary load generator configured. Baseline perf attached to INF-2345. Expected noise window is ~20 minutes during warm-up.
- I ran a short smoke: P99 increase observed only when memory pressure >75% — will add a memory throttle that drops canary to 5% if threshold breached.

I'll keep monitoring and post results to the ticket.

-Jonas
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@oregonanalytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-09T17:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team Weekly: Outstanding Roadmap Points & Exec Inputs

Thanks for the quick follow-up — a couple clarifications from our side before we confirm pilot participation: 
1) Batch-embedding SLA: can you confirm expected 95th percentile latency for 1000-embedding batch on Dedicated vs Hosted?
2) Retention & Compliance: we need explicit retention windows for embeddings in the pilot (30/90/365 days) and whether Aurora Health procurement requires SOC2 evidence (they asked for a copy).

If you can reply inline or drop a short note with numbers, I'll update the procurement team and get back by 11/13. Attached: SOC2_evidence_request_aurora.pdf (they included a template).

Best,
Jordan
Sr Solutions Architect
Oregon Analytics
